title: nepeta nepetella subsp. mallophora
intro: Nepeta nepetella subsp. mallophora, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Mint include soothing digestive issues, relieving respiratory problems, and reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
